g.text: I wanted to ask you something.
All those times you've flirted with me.
Shit you said for a lark?
No, I was just playing around. :/
Honestly? I... can't stop thinking about you.
Is it all just good looks to you?
If you're messing with me, I'll break both your damn ankles.
No...sorry. That's just a shield. The truth is, I honestly can't stop thinking about you.
Hahah sorry! Yeah, it's just how we joke around in the future. [End.]
Then I suggest you spend your time talking to Quincy instead.
The future has a sick sense of humour.
You just threatened to break my ankles!
I know I'm a tough read. I just...had to be sure.
Three emoteethingies must mean something good.
I never said I was always fun to put up with.
Relationships with men like me aren't easy.
For a long time, I considered myself already dead.
And when I became infected, even more so.
But when I met you? I don't know. I felt, for the first time, like I really had someone who I could share the weight with.
I felt like I could shut my eyes for even just a moment and everything would be okay.
With you here, I can breathe.
And I...find myself smiling more. Laughing more.
And I have you to thank for it.
Would you like to make a go at this? You and I?
Are you... asking to date me?
I'm sorry. I'm not ready for this. [Do not date Arthur.]
Yes, you utter berk. What did you think I was asking you?
This is going to take some getting used to, but...what's life without a bit of risk?
You could've just told a man no, for Sol's sake.
Sorry, sometimes I need help translating wherever-the-hell-you're-from.
I just didn't believe you'd put your foot in your mouth like that. [End.]
Though I feel like the others won't let me hear the end of this. :)
I respect that. No hard feelings. Let me know if you change your mind.
Thank you for reminding me why I don't bother with things like this anymore.
They really are going to gossip.
Did... did you just use an emoticon...?
Maybe someday I'll take you there. You'd love it.
You know what? Let them. It'll give them something to do.
And about my question. You and I. What do you think? Want to "date?"
I don't quite know what to say.
Except that for the first time in a long time, I think I'm happy.
You laughed. You know you did.
